title: New Aircrafts & Stunning Liveries in MSFS2024 Marketplace! ✈️✨ | Weekly Update | Week 36
description:
🔍 Description
🚀Explore the latest updates in the Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace this week! Several large airline aircraft, a veteran aircraft, and a general aviation plane have arrived. Plus, a few livery packs are now available to customize your aircraft. Don’t forget to like, comment, and dive into more exciting Microsoft Flight content! 🌍🛫
